title: 우편환법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:10:0:00011:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 10 (Claim by Agent)
(1) When the sender or recipient of an express mail payment requests an agent to make a payment or other claim, the agent must indicate the intention to delegate authority on the back of the express mail receipt or on the relevant claim form, and sign or stamp their name. <Amended April 30, 2007, July 8, 2016>
(2) The agent making a claim as specified in paragraph (1) must indicate on the express mail receipt or the relevant claim form that they are the agent of the sender or recipient, and sign or stamp their name. <Amended July 8, 2016>
